parts.name: AccordionRoot
parts.description: Holds which items are open and shares it with the items inside it.

props.name: value
props.description: The values of the open items. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the accordion.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The values of the items open at first, when it isn't controlled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new list of open values when a trigger asks to open or close an item, and after the browser opened one by itself for find-in-page. A controlled accordion follows `value`. It is called in a change of its own, after the component's: a handler that starts a request, writes what a loading question reads, or is an action that awaits, never holds the component.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Whether several items can be open at once. Without it, opening an item closes the open one, which animates out.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which arrow keys move focus between triggers: Up and Down when `vertical`, Left and Right when `horizontal`.

props.name: loopFocus
props.description: Whether the arrow keys wrap from the last trigger to the first and back.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the accordion is disabled.

parts.name: AccordionItem
parts.description: One item: a `<details>` element holding a trigger and a panel. Style it with `[open]`.

props.name: value
props.description: Identifies the item in the root's `value`. Without it the item gets a generated value.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the item is disabled: its trigger ignores presses and keys, leaves the tab order and is skipped by the arrow keys. Find-in-page still opens it.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the item is asked to open or close, before the root's `onValueChange`. It is called in a change of its own, after the component's: a handler that starts a request, writes what a loading question reads, or is an action that awaits, never holds the component.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item, or the whole accordion, is disabled.

parts.name: AccordionTrigger
parts.description: The `<summary>` that opens and closes its item. It must be the item's first child; put a heading inside it rather than around it. A press asks the root rather than toggling the element, so a controlled `value` decides.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item, or the whole accordion, is disabled.

parts.name: AccordionPanel
parts.description: The item's content, hidden by the browser while the item is closed. It has the `region` role and is labelled by its trigger. Its measured size is written to CSS variables for animating its height.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item, or the whole accordion, is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-ending-style
dataAttributes.description: Present while the panel animates out. The item stays open until the panel's transitions and animations finish.

cssVariables.name: --accordion-panel-height
cssVariables.description: The panel's content height: in px while it opens and closes, `auto` once it is open.

cssVariables.name: --accordion-panel-width
cssVariables.description: The panel's content width: in px while it opens and closes, `auto` once it is open.
